title: What belongs in a good handover

captions.text: Your colleague takes over your project. She only knows what you write down for her.

scenes.title: First say what is done and where it is. Then nobody has to search.

captions.text: First say what is done and where it is. Then nobody has to search.
A short pause to think: What must you include with “done”?

scenes.title: Then what is open. Every open item needs a name: who takes care of it?

captions.text: Finally, fixed dates with the date. “Soon” helps nobody, “on 12 June” does.
A short pause to think: Which sentence helps most in a handover?
